---
title: "Topic: Research & Development activity"
---

**Research & Development (R&D) engagement**

- **Definition:** Whether the firm conducts research and experimental development activities
- **Metric:** Binary indicator (yes/no); frequency (continuous / occasional)
- **Data source:** Primary survey or administrative (R&D tax credit records)

---

**R&D expenditure**

- **Definition:** Total spending on in-house and contracted-out R&D activities
- **Metric:** Total R&D expenditure in €; share of turnover spent on R&D (%)
- **Data source:** Primary survey or administrative (R&D tax credit records, national R&D surveys)

---

**R&D employment**

- **Definition:** Number of staff engaged in R&D activities
- **Metric:** Full-time equivalent (FTE) R&D staff; share of total employees in R&D roles (%)
- **Data source:** Primary survey or administrative

---

**R&D additionality**

- **Definition:** Whether public support leads to an increase in total R&D spending (input additionality) or new products and processes (output additionality), rather than substituting for private investment
- **Metric:** Difference in R&D expenditure or innovation output between treatment and control groups at endline, controlling for baseline
- **Data source:** Primary survey or administrative; requires treatment/control comparison

---
